build_service_class: build a protocol service class at runtime using GeneratedServiceType metaclass with a ServiceDescriptor
build_service_stub_class: build a protocol service stub class at runtime using GeneratedServiceStubType metaclass with a ServiceDescriptor
call_method_on_service: call a service method by name using CallMethod with an rpc_controller, request, and callback
get_request_response_class: get the request or response protocol message class for a given method descriptor
create_stub_rpc_call: create a service stub that wraps an RpcChannel and calls remote methods with callbacks
